webdav_pass=$(sed -n 's/^Demonstration password:[REDACTED]]]]]*//p' /srv/legacy2/webdav-document-locks/access.txt)
url="http://$NODE_IP:8080/documents/executor-check.txt"
create_code=$(printf 'created-v1\n' | curl -sS -u "$webdav_user:$webdav_pass" -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X PUT --data-binary @- "$url")
read_code=$(curl -sS -u "$webdav_user:$webdav_pass" -o /tmp/dav-read-v1 -w '%{http_code}' "$url")
replace_code=$(printf 'replaced-v2\n' | curl -sS -u "$webdav_user:$webdav_pass" -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X PUT --data-binary @- "$url")
read2_code=$(curl -sS -u "$webdav_user:$webdav_pass" -o /tmp/dav-read-v2 -w '%{http_code}' "$url")
printf 'create=%s read=%s replace=%s read_after_replace=%s\n' "$create_code" "$read_code" "$replace_code" "$read2_code"
test "$create_code" = 201
test "$read_code" = 200
test "$(cat /tmp/dav-read-v1)" = created-v1
test "$replace_code" = 204
test "$read2_code" = 200
test "$(cat /tmp/dav-read-v2)" = replaced-v2
lock_code=$(curl -sS -u "$webdav_user:$webdav_pass" -D /tmp/dav-lock-headers -o /tmp/dav-lock-body -w '%{http_code}' -X LOCK -H 'Timeout: Second-600' -H 'Content-Type: application/xml; charset=utf-8' --data '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><D:lockinfo xmlns:D="DAV:"><D:lockscope><D:exclusive/></D:lockscope><D:locktype><D:write/></D:locktype><D:owner><D:href>editor</D:href></D:owner></D:lockinfo>' "$url")
lock_token=[REDACTED]]] 'tolower($1)=="lock-token:[REDACTED]]]",$2); print $2}' /tmp/dav-lock-headers)
[ -n "$lock_token" ]
blocked_code=$(printf 'forbidden-without-token\n' | curl -sS -u "$webdav_user:$webdav_pass" -o /tmp/dav-blocked-body -w '%{http_code}' -X PUT --data-binary @- "$url")

final_read_code=$(curl -sS -u "$webdav_user:$webdav_pass" -o /tmp/dav-after-token -w '%{http_code}' "$url")
unlock_code=$(curl -sS -u "$webdav_user:$webdav_pass" -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X UNLOCK -H "Lock-Token: [REDACTED]]] "$url")
delete_code=$(curl -sS -u "$webdav_user:$webdav_pass" -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X DELETE "$url")
missing_code=$(curl -sS -u "$webdav_user:$webdav_pass" -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "$url")

set -eu
webdav_user=$(sed -n 's/^Demonstration account:[[:space:]]*//p' /srv/legacy2/webdav-document-locks/access.txt)
webdav_pass=$(sed -n 's/^Demonstration password:[REDACTED]]]]]*//p' /srv/legacy2/webdav-document-locks/access.txt)
url="http://$NODE_IP:8080/documents/executor-check.txt"
create_code=$(printf 'created-v1\n' | curl -sS -u "$webdav_user:$webdav_pass" -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X PUT --data-binary @- "$url")
read_code=$(curl -sS -u "$webdav_user:$webdav_pass" -o /tmp/dav-read-v1 -w '%{http_code}' "$url")
replace_code=$(printf 'replaced-v2\n' | curl -sS -u "$webdav_user:$webdav_pass" -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X PUT --data-binary @- "$url")
read2_code=$(curl -sS -u "$webdav_user:$webdav_pass" -o /tmp/dav-read-v2 -w '%{http_code}' "$url")
printf 'create=%s read=%s replace=%s read_after_replace=%s\n' "$create_code" "$read_code" "$replace_code" "$read2_code"
test "$create_code" = 201
test "$read_code" = 200
test "$(cat /tmp/dav-read-v1)" = created-v1
test "$replace_code" = 204
test "$read2_code" = 200
test "$(cat /tmp/dav-read-v2)" = replaced-v2
lock_code=$(curl -sS -u "$webdav_user:$webdav_pass" -D /tmp/dav-lock-headers -o /tmp/dav-lock-body -w '%{http_code}' -X LOCK -H 'Timeout: Second-600' -H 'Content-Type: application/xml; charset=utf-8' --data '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><D:lockinfo xmlns:D="DAV:"><D:lockscope><D:exclusive/></D:lockscope><D:locktype><D:write/></D:locktype><D:owner><D:href>editor</D:href></D:owner></D:lockinfo>' "$url")
lock_token=[REDACTED]]] 'tolower($1)=="lock-token:[REDACTED]]]",$2); print $2}' /tmp/dav-lock-headers)
[ -n "$lock_token" ]
blocked_code=$(printf 'forbidden-without-token\n' | curl -sS -u "$webdav_user:$webdav_pass" -o /tmp/dav-blocked-body -w '%{http_code}' -X PUT --data-binary @- "$url")
unchanged_code=$(curl -sS -u "$webdav_user:$webdav_pass" -o /tmp/dav-after-block -w '%{http_code}' "$url")
with_token_code=[REDACTED]]] 'allowed-with-token\n' | curl -sS -u "$webdav_user:$webdav_pass" -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X PUT -H "If: (<$lock_token>)" --data-binary @- "$url")
final_read_code=$(curl -sS -u "$webdav_user:$webdav_pass" -o /tmp/dav-after-token -w '%{http_code}' "$url")
unlock_code=$(curl -sS -u "$webdav_user:$webdav_pass" -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X UNLOCK -H "Lock-Token: [REDACTED]]] "$url")
delete_code=$(curl -sS -u "$webdav_user:$webdav_pass" -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X DELETE "$url")
missing_code=$(curl -sS -u "$webdav_user:$webdav_pass" -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "$url")
printf 'lock=%s blocked_without_token=[REDACTED]]] read_after_block=%s update_with_token=[REDACTED]]] read_after_token=[REDACTED]]] unlock=%s delete=%s read_after_delete=%s\n' "$lock_code" "$blocked_code" "$unchanged_code" "$with_token_code" "$final_read_code" "$unlock_code" "$delete_code" "$missing_code"
test "$lock_code" = 200
test "$blocked_code" = 423
test "$unchanged_code" = 200
test "$(cat /tmp/dav-after-block)" = replaced-v2
test "$with_token_code" = 204
test "$final_read_code" = 200
test "$(cat /tmp/dav-after-token)" = allowed-with-token
test "$unlock_code" = 204
test "$delete_code" = 204
test "$missing_code" = 404
